$comment: All durable harness state, owned by the CLI (./AGENTS.sh) — never hand-edit. Keys: setup (present only while guided setup is pending; init drives it), commands (via `cmd set/rm`; verify = definition-of-done step, init = session-start check), features (via `feature ...`; max one in_progress, never delete — mark done), progress (via `log`; append-only, display bounded by the CLI), rules (via `docs add/rm`; curated project knowledge). Future harness versions may add top-level keys. Transient scratch lives in agents.scratch.json (gitignored).

features.title: Fix essentiaNnls timeout (>120s, never completes)
features.notes: Benchmark: TIMEOUT for any clip (>=6s exceeds 120s budget). Root cause: per-frame Essentia Windowing+Spectrum+LogSpectrum at FRAME_SIZE=16384 costs ~350ms/frame; detector re-extracts the ENTIRE ~79-frame window (HOP_SIZE=2048, ANALYSIS_WINDOW_SECONDS=4) every ANALYSIS_INTERVAL_MS=500 -> O(n^2) recompute, ~28s per analysis. Even perfectly incremental, ~646 unique frames over a 30s clip x 350ms = ~226s, still over budget -> frame cost itself must drop. Secondary bug: NNLSChroma useNNLS=true pass returns empty EVERY time (fellBack=true always), and the linear-fallback result is WRONG (G major on c_major). Fix: (1) incremental per-frame log-spectrum cache (no full-window recompute); (2) lighter frame params (smaller FRAME_SIZE / larger HOP) to get under 120s; (3) investigate why NNLS mode yields all-zero chroma + why result lands on dominant. Re-benchmark after. File: src/detection/specifics/essentia-nnls-detector.js

features.title: Fix meyda non-power-of-2 final chunk error
features.notes: Benchmark: meyda runs and is CORRECT (C major), but logs 'Meyda: Buffer size must be a power of 2'. Cause: runner feeds a final partial PCM chunk (pcm.slice tail, not power of 2); Meyda.bufferSize is pinned to bufferSize=4096 at init, so the short last chunk throws inside Meyda.extract. Caught by worker (non-fatal) so result is unaffected, but it pollutes logs and aborts that chunk's feature. Fix: in MeydaDetector.process, skip/guard chunks whose length != this.bufferSize (or pad). File: src/detection/specifics/meyda-detector.js. NOTE: same warning surfaces via ensemble (F-00008) since it composes meyda.

features.title: Verify ensemble after meyda fix (inherits power-of-2 error)
features.notes: Benchmark: ensemble runs and is CORRECT (C major) but emits the same 'Meyda: Buffer size must be a power of 2' warning because it composes MeydaDetector. Likely resolved by F-00007. Task: after F-00007, re-run benchmark for ensemble, confirm no warning and accuracy unchanged. If ensemble instantiates/feeds meyda differently than the standalone detector, apply the same non-power-of-2 guard at the ensemble feed site. File: src/detection/specifics/ensemble-detector.js

features.title: Fix webaudioPcp detecting dominant (G major on c_major)
features.notes: Benchmark: webaudioPcp RUNS (27 updates, fast) but returns WRONG key: G major on c_major (firstCorrectMs=557 then drifts to dominant by end; final=G major, correct=false). Not a crash -> accuracy bug. Hypothesis: PCP/harmonic weighting over-weights the dominant (G is the 5th of C; strong harmonic overlap), or profile-matching/rotation picks relative dominant. Compare against essentia HPCP (correct) on same audio. Task: dump averaged chroma + profile-match scores for c_major, find why G outranks C; check harmonic summation (overtones of C reinforce G) and profile correlation. Re-benchmark across all 9 tunes after, not just c_major. File: src/detection/specifics/webaudio-pcp-detector.js (+ src/detection/profile-matching.js)

rules.text: Audio: mic -> AudioWorklet (4096 PCM) -> Web Worker (src/audio/worker.js) -> KeyDetector. Detectors in src/detection/specifics/, registered in src/detection/factory.js, lazy-loaded.
Detection result contract: { tonic, mode, score, confidence, alternate, chroma }; mode is 'major'|'minor' only.
Profile matching: src/detection/profile-matching.js — Krumhansl-Schmuckler major/minor, Pearson, common-session-key boost. 24 candidates.
Modes = major/minor only. No dorian/mixolydian/etc — that complexity killed bourdon.
Large binaries (WAV, ONNX) never in repo; host on Cloudflare R2 (r2-assets.json + README). No Git LFS.
Never test via vite dev; always npm run build + serve dist/ (npm run preview). playwright.config.js webServer enforces this.
Benchmark ground truth = abc/ filenames; modal tunes map by third: lydian/mixolydian->major, dorian/phrygian->minor.
e2e chromium auto-installed by init cmd 'browsers' (npx playwright install chromium). Fake mic via launch flags in playwright.config.js.

R2 base URL: https://r2-fiddlekey.bysander.net. Agents have NO R2 credentials; never script uploads. New large asset: script to fetch/generate it + name suggestion + r2-assets.json entry, then ask human to upload.
Benchmark: /benchmark page, window.fiddlekeyBenchmark.run({detectors,tunes,durationSec,noise:{type,snrDb,seed}}); deterministic minus wallMs; noise types session/babble/white
